caption:
Taiwan votes Saturday in local elections as officials warn of China interference

Voters will choose mayors, council members and other local leaders across 22 districts. The results will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive party.

Reported by The Guardian; Bloomberg.

body: Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday, Nov 28. Taiwanese officials have raised alarm over Chinese interference in the elections. The vote may shape early moves for the 2028 presidential race.
